# M018 A2A synthetic fixtures

Everything in this directory is deliberately non-scientific test data.

- Values and names are placeholders for schema and deterministic-rule tests.
- No item is an electrolyte, electrode, reactor, experiment, or recommendation.
- No fixture may be presented as a real candidate or included in a Top-11 list.
- Fixture design cards must carry the exact label `NON_SCIENTIFIC_FIXTURE`.
